Invisibility Quirk.name: Invisibility Quirk
Invisibility Quirk.description:
🫥 Your body is invisible all the time: skin, hair, eyes and nails.

🌱 At the start you bend light around a gloved fist for an unseen blow and slip out of people's notice by standing still.
📈 With training: light flashed into a foe's eyes, every camera in a building mapped, unseen sprints, a person you hold hidden, bonds burned through, a whole group hidden.
⚠️ Clothes and carried things still show, so you must shed them to vanish fully, and you still make noise, leave footprints and have a scent.
🔗 Common drawback pairing: Visible Tell, as pushed light flickers your outline into view.
🎬 Similar canon Quirks: Toru Hagakure (Invisibility).

📈 Grants: Speed +1, Quirk Control +10, Quirk Analysis +10, Stealth +5
⚡ Starting techniques: Empty-Air Strike, Out of Mind
Invisibility Quirk.traitNarrativeEffects: Scale: the whole body is permanently invisible (skin, hair, eyes, nails); they see normally and cast no shadow. Clothes and held things stay visible, so full stealth means nothing worn or carried. At first: bending light around a gloved hand for a few seconds. More needs learned techniques. Limits: footsteps, breath, scent and prints in dust or rain give them away; thermal cameras find them. Light tricks fail in darkness; erasure never reveals the body but stops light tricks. People forget the user is there. Quirk Strain: none to be invisible; light: unseen blow, fading from notice; moderate: dazzle, sight-line survey, vanishing sprint; heavy: hiding a held person, burning point; severe: signature burst, hiding a group. Type: Mutant. Law: sneaking into homes or changing rooms is trespass or voyeurism; an unlicensed strike from hiding is assault. Look: visible clothes on an unseen form (portraits: outfit only); light tricks: faint warp, then bright point or flash.
